title: FUN3D: NASA's Flow Solver
description: FUN3D (Fully Unstructured Navier-Stokes 3D) is NASA Langley's computational fluid dynamics suite for compressible flow — subsonic to hypersonic — on unstructured grids. It models the air around launch vehicles, capsules, and high-speed aircraft, and it has supported SLS, Orion, and the X-59 quiet supersonic program. It is one of NASA's workhorse CFD codes.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: The Navier-Stokes Equations
description: FUN3D solves the Navier-Stokes equations — conservation of mass, momentum, and energy for a viscous, compressible fluid — discretized on the grid. Everything in CFD is these equations plus models for what the grid cannot resolve. Understanding them is understanding the tool.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Unstructured Grids
description: Unstructured grids use tetrahedra, prisms, and pyramids that fit complex vehicle shapes — capsules with launch abort towers, SLS with boosters — where structured grids struggle. FUN3D's grid adapts: fine near walls and shocks, coarse in the far field. Grid quality directly sets solution quality.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: RANS Turbulence Modeling
description: FUN3D's Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes mode models turbulence with closures like Spalart-Allmaras and SST instead of resolving every eddy — the affordable way to get vehicle forces and heating. Turbulence models are calibrated, not derived, which is why validation matters. RANS is the daily driver of aerospace CFD.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

t: DES: When RANS Is Not Enough
title: DES: When RANS Is Not Enough
description: Detached-Eddy Simulation blends RANS near walls with eddy-resolving LES in separated regions — for buffet, wake flows, and launch-vehicle base flows where RANS averages away the physics that matters. DES costs far more than RANS and far less than full LES. Engineers spend the compute where the flow demands it.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Hypersonics and Re-entry Heating
description: At hypersonic speeds the air dissociates and ionizes — FUN3D models thermochemical nonequilibrium to predict the heat flux that sizes the heat shield. Shock-layer radiation adds to convective heating on lunar-return trajectories. Getting heating wrong means losing the vehicle, so these models are validated relentlessly.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Adjoint-Based Design Optimization
description: FUN3D's adjoint solver computes how every design variable affects the objective — drag, lift, heating — in about the cost of one flow solution, no matter how many variables. That gradient drives shape optimization: the wing or capsule reshapes itself toward better performance. This is CFD doing design, not just analysis.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: SLS Aerodynamics
description: FUN3D modeled the Space Launch System's aerodynamics — the full stack with boosters, core, and Orion — predicting forces, buffet, and base heating through ascent. Wind-tunnel data validated the predictions. Launch vehicle aerodynamics is FUN3D's home turf.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Orion and Capsule Flows
description: Blunt capsules like Orion create detached bow shocks and unsteady wakes — FUN3D predicts the heating distribution and aerodynamic stability that the design depends on. Capsule aerodynamics looks simple and is not. The solver earns its keep on every entry.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: X-59: Quiet Supersonics
description: The X-59 program shapes its aircraft so the sonic boom arrives as a soft thump — FUN3D's adjoint optimization sculpted the airframe to manage shock placement. CFD designed the quiet. Flight tests will confirm what the solver predicted.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

t: Verification: The Method of Manufactured Solutions
title: Verification: The Method of Manufactured Solutions
description: FUN3D is verified with manufactured solutions — choose an answer, derive the source terms that produce it, and check the code recovers it at the theoretical order of accuracy. This proves the discretization is correct independent of physics. Verification first, validation second, always.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Validation: Wind Tunnels and Flight
description: FUN3D predictions are validated against wind-tunnel measurements and flight data — forces, pressures, heating — with quantified uncertainty. A validated configuration is one where predictions match data within known bounds. Validation never ends; each new vehicle re-earns it.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Running FUN3D at Scale
description: Production FUN3D runs use thousands of cores: the grid partitions across MPI ranks, and strong scaling determines how big a problem finishes overnight. A full-vehicle RANS case is routine; a DES of a launch vehicle is a campaign. Compute planning is part of CFD.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Solution Adaptation
description: FUN3D adapts the grid to the solution — refining where error indicators are high (shocks, shear layers) and coarsening where the flow is smooth. Adaptation buys accuracy without globally refining. The grid follows the physics.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

t: The FUN3D Workflow End to End
title: The FUN3D Workflow End to End
description: Ladder-top FUN3D: build the geometry, generate the adapted grid, set the physics models, solve, check forces and heating, validate against data, and optimize the shape with adjoints. Fifteen rungs from equations to designed flight hardware.
